response.query: What regulatory evidence package will we pursue for FDA/EMA alignment (type of clinical endpoints, MRMC reader-study results, real-world evidence, software lifecycle documentation), and which data governance model (centralized vs federated) and privacy controls will we adopt?
response.answer: For FDA/EMA alignment, we will pursue a regulatory evidence package with clinical endpoints, MRMC reader-study results, and software lifecycle documentation. We will adopt a centralized data governance model with stringent privacy controls.
